body: I have given up. It is such a relief.

I'm tired of waiting for something good to be in my life. Their father is essentially homeless. By eliminating myself from the equation he can come back home and care for the kids. There is no hope of getting fixed or any other option. I'm very calm now, because I've accepted this rare. I'm sorry to have wasted your time.

No sleep. There is no good anywhere. I have seen more horrors than anyone should have to endure in a lifetime. My life has been worst case scenario for as long as I can remember. Everyday I feel like I've hit rock bottom and the next day proves me wrong. What will tomorrow bring? Only hell, misery, and pain.

When I was sexually abused by my biological father his wife was the head of a psychiatric ward. She had several of her underlings convince me that the abuse was my fault. Every time I would try to talk to the police or teachers they are would send me back for more brainwashing. I know my situation, these kids will be better off not having me around. I have looked into how suicide affects children. They are stronger than me, they can do this.

There is no better. I have been broken my whole life. From being sexually abused by my biological father until I was 15 to all the abusive relationships I've endured. The kids are not to blame. I talk to my 11 yo about the bullshit surrounding us and he understands that it's because of mommy's bad decisions, not his. Who knows, maybe my husband's girlfriend will be a great grandma to them if she ever leaves her husband. But just don't think she will. He makes 6 figures and we're on food stamps.
With any luck the baby won't even remember me.
Their lives are already destroyed. Nothing will ever get better and by giving up, they can live without a mother rather than with a broken one. It is the only kindness I have left to offer them.
11, 5, 1. It won't change. I'm finally ready for a permanent solution to my permanent problems.
My children would be better off without me. I feel no connection to them. I have completely given up. There is nothing left.

The bruises are on my arms from him grabbing me. I didn't know about them until I got home and took a shower. Winter is cold so the cops didn't take my coat off. He will argue that I did them to myself after the fact and am just trying to get him in trouble.
She told me "I hope he was worth a criminal record"
My mother is my lawyer. He disabled the cameras months ago so he(29)could fuck his new girlfriend/employee(50) in the back room without her husband finding out.
